:::{#def-symmetric-part}
#### Symmetric part of a square matrix

The **symmetric part** of a $p \times p$ matrix $\matr{S}$ is

$$\frac{1}{2}\paren{\matr{S} + \tp{\matr{S}}}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-symmetric-part}
#### The symmetric part of a $2 \times 2$ matrix

For $\matr{S} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 \end{bmatrix}$,
the symmetric part is

$$
\frac{1}{2}\paren{
\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 \end{bmatrix}
+ \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 3 \end{bmatrix}
}
= \frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \\ 2 & 6 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 \end{bmatrix},
$$

which is symmetric.

:::
